verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase is explicitly documented as a serverless framework that runs backend code automatically in response to background events, HTTPS requests, Admin SDK actions, or scheduler jobs, including Firebase Authentication triggers and Cloud Storage/Firestore triggers. This directly matches the story of running functions in response to database/auth events. missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically confirming database/auth trigger reliability (community evidence focuses on other pain points, not this specific capability).
